//: Bodies of people (15 §9.2). A member with no relation of its own toward someone uses its group's, toward that persona or toward a group the persona claims: an open member's true persona claims its groups, as colours or a uniform would. Every person the `person` template makes is one of the townsfolk.
name: the townsfolk
doc: The ordinary people of a town: friendly enough to each other, glad of the watch and afraid of the gang.

name: the Watch
doc: The town's watch: they stand together, look after the townsfolk and take the gang for enemies. A sergeant may order guards and spend from what the watch holds.

name: the gang
doc: A street gang: they stand together and take the watch for enemies.
